description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableSearchProperty' implementing 'SearchProperty', providing various methods to create search filters based on property paths and values, used for querying JSON-like data structures within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchProperty
classes.description: An immutable implementation of SearchProperty providing filter creation methods based on property path and value.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableSearchProperty instance with the given property path.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if the property exists.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Creates an equality filter for boolean, int, long, double, or String values.

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Creates a not-equal filter for boolean, int, long, double, or String values.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Creates a greater-than-or-equal filter for boolean, int, long, double, or String values.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Creates a greater-than filter for boolean, int, long, double, or String values.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Creates a less-than-or-equal filter for boolean, int, long, double, or String values.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Creates a less-than filter for boolean, int, long, double, or String values.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a filter for pattern matching with a String value.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates an 'in' filter with multiple values for boolean, int, long, double, or String types.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the property path associated with this search property.
